name: Oral: planlama, indirim, tedaviye aktarim, tedavi sirasi, mantik kurallari
description: TEST hastasi uzerinde planlama kalemleri eklenir, indirim uygulanir, Tedavi sekmesine aktarilir. Mantiksal kurallar denetlenir.

planSteps.description: Log in with the TEST account credentials configured for this project
Open the patient 'TEST Senaryo HASTA' and go to the 'Oral' tab, then open the 'Planlama 1' sub tab
In the right panel choose any tariff item that has a price (for example a filling) and click tooth 16 in the tooth chart
Verify the item is listed in the Planlama 1 items card with tooth number 16 and a doctor name, and that tooth 16 is NOT surrounded by a blue box
Choose another priced tariff item and click tooth 26, then click the 'Tumunu Sec' button in the items card
Verify all items in the plan are checked and the plan total equals the sum of the item prices
Click the 'Indirim' button, choose percent, enter 10 and apply
Verify each item shows a 10 percent discount and the plan total is 10 percent lower than before
With all items selected click the 'Tedavi' copy target, confirm the transfer date and click 'Aktar'
Verify both items now appear as treatments, with the discounted prices, and the most recently added treatment is at the top of the list
Go back to 'Planlama 1', choose a tariff whose name contains 'Implant' (an implant placement) and click tooth 16 which already has a planned filling
Verify the system refuses with a message that natural tooth tissue exists and extraction is needed first
